{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Unique patient_id: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Duplicate patient_id count: {len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
df_baseline_neg999 = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999]
print(f"Number of rows with biomarker_baseline == -999: {len(df_baseline_neg999)}")

# Check sample_seq distribution per patient
df_sample_seq_max = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
df_sample_seq_max_counts = df_sample_seq_max.value_counts()
print(f"Distribution of max sample_seq per patient: {df_sample_seq_max_counts.to_dict()}")"}
